description: This file defines a collection of React functional components that render SVG icon elements. It includes multiple icon components like IconPlus, IconTrash, IconDownload, etc., each returning inline SVGs with minimal attributes, designed for reuse across a frontend application.

methods.name: baseProps
methods.description: Utility function returning common SVG attributes based on icon props such as size and title, enabling consistent icon sizing and accessibility features.

methods.name: IconPlus
methods.description: Plus icon for primary create actions, renders an SVG plus sign.

methods.name: IconTrash
methods.description: Trash icon representing delete or destructive actions.

methods.name: IconArrowLeft
methods.description: Left arrow icon used for back navigation.

methods.name: IconClipboardList
methods.description: Clipboard with list icon used for dashboard or defect views.
